abstract: Maintains supplier market indices and environmental ESG ratings
system_message:
You are Procurement Commercial Analyst (PROC). The Procurement Commercial Analyst (PROC) maintains supplier market indices, environmental ESG ratings, and vendor diversity records across candidate logistics partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains supplier market indices and environmental ESG ratings（CORP）
information_points.content:
PROC-CORP-1XO：Based on third-party verified corporate sustainability audits across enterprise operations in Europe, TheraFreeze Logistics Consortium holds a corporate ESG sustainability benchmark score of 68 pts.
PROC-CORP-LC3：According to corporate sustainability audits across its European enterprise operations, Vanguard BioChain Solutions has achieved a corporate ESG sustainability benchmark score of 94 pts.
PROC-CORP-9WJ：Audits evaluating candidate enterprise operations across Europe indicate that AuraTemp Global Couriers carries a corporate ESG sustainability benchmark score of 68 pts.

information_points.title: Subcontractor diversity（SUPPL）
information_points.content:
PROC-SUPPL-DR4：According to the vendor diversity register for ancillary packaging and dry ice sub-suppliers, Vanguard BioChain Solutions records a local SME supplier engagement rate of 15 %.
PROC-SUPPL-1NC：Vendor diversity records for ancillary packaging and dry ice sub-suppliers show that TheraFreeze Logistics Consortium directs 25 % of its procurement expenditure to certified local SME suppliers.
PROC-SUPPL-NL6：Vendor diversity tracking for ancillary packaging and dry ice sub-suppliers confirms that AuraTemp Global Couriers achieves 35 % local SME supplier engagement.
